{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research and Development Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year average of research and development expenses divided by the 3-year average of sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms that efficiently allocate resources to research and development are more likely to produce innovative products and services, leading to higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl index of customer concentration using Compustat data on sales by segment and customer, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms with diversified customer bases are less exposed to customer-specific risks, which can lead to higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Resilience", "construction": "Calculate the average days inventory outstanding and days payables outstanding over the past year, using Compustat data, and then compute the ratio of the two", "rationale": "Firms with more resilient supply chains, as evidenced by efficient inventory management and payment practices, are better positioned to weather economic shocks", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Diversification Benefit", "construction": "Compute the fraction of foreign sales to total sales, using Compustat data, and then calculate the standard deviation of this ratio over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with geographically diversified sales are less exposed to country-specific risks, which can lead to higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Overhang", "construction": "Calculate the total value of outstanding employee stock options, using Thomson Financial data, and then divide by the total market capitalization", "rationale": "Firms with high levels of employee stock option overhang may experience decreased employee motivation and increased agency costs, leading to lower future returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Quality", "construction": "Compute a governance score based on the presence of independent board members, audit committee independence, and other governance metrics, using RiskMetrics data", "rationale": "Firms with high-quality corporate governance are more likely to make decisions that benefit shareholders, leading to higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Sustainability Performance", "construction": "Calculate a sustainability score based on environmental metrics such as greenhouse gas emissions, water usage, and waste management, using Trucost data", "rationale": "Firms with strong environmental sustainability performance may experience reduced regulatory risks and increased long-term viability", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Market Competition", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl index of industry concentration using Compustat data on sales by segment and industry, averaged over the past 2 years", "rationale": "Firms operating in less competitive industries may experience higher future returns due to reduced competitive pressures", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Compensation Alignment", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of CEO total compensation to firm market capitalization, using Thomson Financial data", "rationale": "Firms with executive compensation structures that align with shareholder interests may experience higher future returns due to increased management motivation", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Innovation Network Centrality", "construction": "Compute a measure of a firm's centrality in the innovation network, based on patent citations and collaborations, using PatentVest data", "rationale": "Firms that are central to the innovation network may experience increased knowledge spillovers and collaboration opportunities, leading to higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
